lines.text: Moses tells Israel to appoint judges and officials in every town, and to pursue justice alone to possess the land.
Israel must not set up an Asherah pole by the altar, and must not sacrifice a flawed ox or sheep.
If a report of worshiping other gods is true, the person is stoned at the town gates on the testimony of two or three witnesses.
A case too difficult to judge goes up to the place the LORD will choose, to the Levitical priests and the judge.
The king must not acquire many horses or wives, and he must read his scroll all the days of his life.
